root_cause.text: The `last_tx_at` field was a 64-bit `time64_t` that was written and read without synchronization, causing data races and potential load/store tearing on 32-bit architectures.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "as ->last_tx_at is a 64-bit value, tearing can occur on a 32-bit arch" and "Fix both of these by switching to an unsigned int for ->last_tx_at and only storing the LSW of the time64_t." The patch changes the type from `time64_t` to `unsigned int` and adds `WRITE_ONCE`/`READ_ONCE` to avoid data races and tearing.
